title: Mixing: Wings Over America by Wings | 1976
content:
Abbey Road Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineers: Phil McDonald, Mark Vigars, Tom Walsh

Wings continued mixing the live album Wings Over America on 15 November 1976.

On this day, the tenth of 13 mixing sessions, the songs ‘Listen To What The Man Said’, ‘Let ’Em In’, and ‘Time To Hide’ were worked on.

‘Listen To What The Man Said’ had been recorded on 29 May 1976 at the Kemper Arena in, Kansas City. ‘Let ’Em In’ was from 23 June 1976 at the Forum, Inglewood, and ‘Time To Hide’ was taped on 25 May 1976 at New York’s Madison Square Garden.
